Hankel matrix of shifted lattice values

Source: R/binomial_lattice_fast.R
lattice_hankel.Rd

The n_rows x n_shifts matrix whose (r, c) entry is values[first_row + r - 1 + first_shift + c - 1], and fill where that index leaves 1, ..., N. The same as lattice_shift_matrix() for contiguous rows and shifts, built from one contiguous segment of the vector, whose index vector sequence() builds in a single pass.

Usage

lattice_hankel(values, first_row, n_rows, first_shift, n_shifts, fill = 0)

Arguments

values

A vector of length N.

first_row, n_rows

First row position and number of rows.

first_shift, n_shifts

First shift and number of shifts.

fill

Value outside the lattice.

Value

A n_rows x n_shifts matrix.
